notes: «وَ كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ» names neither writer nor addressee: prev1 to prev3 write no chain, so the asker and the Imam are taken from prev4, the nearest report that names its speaker (owner ruling, «و كتب إليه»)
«فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ» is the Imam's answer: the last link, as prev4 names him
